claims.summary: Digital Daijisen records フロント as front/front side, hotel reception (shortened from front desk), and the front office/leadership of a professional baseball club.
The MHLW job tag describes hotel/ryokan front-desk work as lodging procedures, room allocation, messages, information, payment, check-in and check-out.
フロントガラス is the wind-protective glass at the front of a car, called windshield or windscreen in English.
The dictionary cites フロントに電話して from Furukawa Roppa’s diary dated 1940-08-23 as an example for the hotel reception sense.
The translation of フロント depends on its dictionary sense and compound: reception in hotels, front/forepart in general and front office leadership in pro baseball.
